Zenzsual Affiliate Program – Created by Doctors, Inspired by Real Women

At Zenzsual, we believe that women's wellness deserves science, heart, and honesty. Our brand was founded by two doctors and clinical sexologists who, beyond being medical experts, are also women, wives, mothers, and survivors. We've lived every stage—from puberty to menopause—and that's why we don’t just know, we understand.

Our line of feminine wellness products is designed to support women through hormonal changes, vaginal health concerns, low libido, menopause, and emotional well-being. From probiotics to CBD, intimate care to libido boosters, our solutions are natural, effective, and rooted in medical knowledge and lived experience.

Affiliates earn 20% commission on every confirmed sale, with monthly payouts via PayPal or bank transfer. We provide marketing support, exclusive discount codes, educational resources, and a welcoming community focused on purpose-driven impact.

But more importantly, when you join Zenzsual, you are not simply promoting products—you are helping us educate, empower, and uplift women through science-based wellness.

Important Policy Regarding Paid Advertising (Google Ads)

To protect the integrity of our brand and ensure fair collaboration with all affiliates, any traffic generated through Google Ads or other paid advertising platforms must be approved in advance by the Zenzsual team.

If you plan to promote Zenzsual using paid ads, you must submit the following information for review before running campaigns:

• The Google Ads account ID used for the campaign
• The ad creative (copy and visuals) you plan to use
• The keywords or search terms you intend to target

Our team will review this information to determine whether the campaign complies with our brand and marketing guidelines.

Please note that:

• Commissions generated through unauthorized paid advertising campaigns may be declined.
• Brand bidding or misleading advertising is strictly prohibited.
• Approval must be obtained before launching the campaign.

This policy ensures transparency, protects the brand, and allows us to work together effectively while maintaining a fair environment for all affiliates.
__________________________________________

Self-Referral Policy

Affiliates are not permitted to earn commissions on purchases made through their own affiliate links or discount codes.

Orders identified as self-referrals, including purchases made by the affiliate, members of their household, or using the affiliate’s own payment method, may be declined or removed from commission eligibility.

Our system automatically monitors and flags these activities to ensure fairness and transparency within the affiliate program.

Affiliate Program Policies | Políticas del Programa de Afiliados

1️⃣ Commission Payment & Eligibility | Pago de Comisiones y Elegibilidad

✅ Affiliates earn a 20% commission on each sale made through their unique affiliate link or coupon.
✅ Commissions are calculated based on the final amount paid by the customer after discounts. Taxes and shipping costs are not included in the commission calculation.
✅ Payments are processed within the first 10 days of the following month.
✅ To receive payment, affiliates must accumulate a minimum of $100 in commissions.
✅ Affiliates must submit the required tax form annually:

  • U.S. residents: W-9 Form
  • Non-U.S. residents: W-8BEN Form
    ✅ Commissions will only be paid if the affiliate’s profile in our platform is fully completed and updated.

✅ Los afiliados ganan un 20% de comisión por cada venta realizada a través de su enlace de afiliado o cupón.
✅ Las comisiones se calculan sobre el monto final pagado por el cliente, después de aplicar descuentos. Los impuestos y costos de envío no se incluyen en el cálculo de comisiones.
✅ Los pagos se procesan dentro de los primeros 10 días del mes siguiente.
✅ Para recibir el pago, los afiliados deben acumular un mínimo de $100 en comisiones.
✅ Los afiliados deben enviar el formulario fiscal requerido anualmente:

  • Residentes de EE.UU.: Formulario W-9
  • No residentes de EE.UU.: Formulario W-8BEN
    ✅ Las comisiones solo serán pagadas si el perfil del afiliado en nuestra plataforma está completamente actualizado.

2️⃣ Tracking & Lost Commissions | Rastreo y Comisiones No Registradas

⚠️ We cannot manually adjust commissions for sales that were not tracked due to improper link usage or customer behavior outside our control. Affiliates are responsible for guiding customers to use their referral links correctly.
⚠️ If an affiliate suspects a missing commission, they must report it within 10 days of the purchase date, providing relevant details for review.
⚠️ If a sale is canceled or refunded, the commission for that sale will be deducted from the affiliate’s balance.

⚠️ No podemos ajustar manualmente comisiones de ventas que no fueron rastreadas debido a un uso incorrecto del enlace o al comportamiento del cliente fuera de nuestro control. Los afiliados son responsables de guiar a sus clientes para que usen correctamente su enlace de referido.
⚠️ Si un afiliado sospecha que falta una comisión, debe reportarlo dentro de los 10 días posteriores a la fecha de compra, proporcionando los detalles necesarios para la revisión.
⚠️ Si una venta es cancelada o reembolsada, la comisión de esa venta será deducida del balance del afiliado.

3️⃣ Google Ads & Paid Advertising Restrictions | Uso de Google Ads y Restricciones de Publicidad Paga

🚨 Google Ads and other paid advertising methods are NOT allowed unless explicitly approved in writing by our team.
🚨 Brand bidding is strictly prohibited. Affiliates may not use our brand names ("Zenzsual," "TuSaludIntima," "CBDZen") as keywords in search campaigns.
🚨 Misleading promotions such as false discounts or unapproved offers are not allowed.
🚨 If an affiliate wishes to run Google Ads, they must submit the following information for approval:

  • Screenshots or direct links to the ads.
  • List of keywords being used.
  • Geographic targeting of the campaign.
  • Google Ads account ID.
    ⚠️ Failure to comply with these guidelines may result in account termination and commission forfeiture.

🚨 No se permite el uso de Google Ads ni otros métodos de publicidad paga sin aprobación previa y por escrito de nuestro equipo.
🚨 Está estrictamente prohibido el uso de nuestra marca en publicidad paga. Los afiliados no pueden utilizar los nombres "Zenzsual," "TuSaludIntima," "CBDZen" como palabras clave en campañas de búsqueda.
🚨 No se permiten promociones engañosas, como descuentos falsos u ofertas no aprobadas.
🚨 Si un afiliado desea utilizar Google Ads, debe enviar la siguiente información para aprobación:

  • Capturas de pantalla o enlaces directos a los anuncios.
  • Lista de palabras clave utilizadas.
  • Ubicación geográfica de la campaña.
  • ID de la cuenta de Google Ads.
    ⚠️ El incumplimiento de estas normas puede resultar en la suspensión de la cuenta y pérdida de comisiones.

4️⃣ Affiliate Conduct & Brand Protection | Conducta del Afiliado y Protección de Marca

🔹 Affiliates must represent the brand ethically and professionally. Any misleading claims, false advertising, or unauthorized discount offers will result in immediate termination.
🔹 Affiliates are prohibited from using unauthorized sales channels, such as unauthorized third-party websites or bulk discount marketplaces.
🔹 Affiliates may not engage in any behavior that damages the reputation of Zenzsual, TuSaludIntima, or CBDZen.

🔹 Los afiliados deben representar la marca de manera ética y profesional. Cualquier afirmación engañosa, publicidad falsa u ofertas de descuento no autorizadas resultará en la terminación inmediata del afiliado.
🔹 No se permite el uso de canales de venta no autorizados, como sitios web de terceros no aprobados o mercados de descuentos masivos.
🔹 Los afiliados no pueden realizar actividades que perjudiquen la reputación de Zenzsual, TuSaludIntima o CBDZen.

5️⃣  Policy Agreement & Enforcement | Aceptación y Cumplimiento de Políticas

📌 By participating in our affiliate program, you agree to these policies. Failure to comply may result in commission loss, account suspension, or permanent removal from the program.
📌 We reserve the right to update these policies at any time. Affiliates will be notified of major changes.

📌 Al participar en nuestro programa de afiliados, aceptas estas políticas. El incumplimiento puede resultar en la pérdida de comisiones, suspensión de cuenta o eliminación permanente del programa.
📌 Nos reservamos el derecho de actualizar estas políticas en cualquier momento. Los afiliados serán notificados sobre cambios importantes.
